claim_one_line: THE SHADOW LIBRARY, THE ORPHANED CORE, AND ONE NON-FINDING. The code sweep's second return, counted over the tree rather than quoted -- distinct files, never match counts, with this arc's own files excluded from every count. THE CORRECTION, and this refresh was carrying the wrong premise too: 'frontier/ is 1,687 standalone .py files with no shared library and no imports between them' IS FALSE. 227 frontier files manipulate sys.path, and there is a DE-FACTO SHADOW LIBRARY reached by path surgery instead of packaging -- frontier/B358_seam_certification/cyclo_engine.py has 56 importers and frontier/B367_value_map/step0_exact_matrices.py has 46, and BOTH ARE FILED AS ORDINARY RESEARCH ARCS with their own arc_verdict.json while functioning as infrastructure for roughly a hundred other cells. WHY THAT MATTERS BEYOND TIDINESS: an arc that a hundred cells import is not a cell, it is a dependency, and the corpus has no way to say so -- it carries a VERDICT, not a VERSION; a correction to it silently changes every consumer's results and nothing in the governance layer would register that. This is a consolidation-debt row the prose ledgers structurally cannot see, the campaign's own concern in the one dimension it never measured. THE CERTIFIED CORE IS ORPHANED, AND IT IS ADOPTION DEBT NOT MISSING CODE: 6 of 1,687 frontier files import origin_axiom (0.36 percent), and they are B1_gluing_chern_simons, B5_wheeler_dewitt, B6_field_equation, B8_particle_spectrum, B9_fusion_scattering -- plus B1034, yesterday. THE CERTIFIED CORE HAS HAD NO NEW CONSUMER BETWEEN B9 AND B1034, a thousand arcs. Meanwhile 220 frontier files redefine L, R or A INLINE and NOT ONE of them imports the core, while src/origin_axiom/algebra.py has defined L, R and A = L*R the whole time. The fix is not writing code; the code exists and nothing reaches for it. Same shape one level down: the TRACE MAP, the substrate the atlas measures at 45 percent of all probes, is re-derived in 80 frontier files and has NO HOME IN src/ AT ALL -- the most-duplicated primitive with nowhere to import from -- and tests/helpers_e6.py, the repo's one factored-out helper, lives in tests/ and serves ZERO frontier files. SHARED KERNELS MAKE 'INDEPENDENT' ARCS LESS INDEPENDENT THAN THEY LOOK: in the densest computational band, B930's overlap.py and B935's compose.py share a BYTE-IDENTICAL kernel -- dozens of functions, hundreds of lines of the exact-arithmetic layer (kmul, kinv, root_in_K, normalize27) copied rather than imported, with the same core recurring across B928, B938, B914, B916 and B923. A BUG IN THAT KERNEL REPRODUCES IDENTICALLY IN BOTH ARCS RATHER THAN BEING CAUGHT BY DISAGREEMENT, so where two such arcs agree the agreement is weaker evidence than it appears -- not because either is wrong but because COPYING IS NOT INDEPENDENCE. Stated as a limit on evidence, not as a defect in any arc; no banked result is challenged, only the reading of cross-arc agreement between copy-siblings as confirmation. THE INSTRUMENT INDEX FROZE AT B370: docs/TOOLBOX.md names about 9 code paths and its highest cited arc is B370 against a corpus at B1035, with doc-currency already flagging it at lag 660 and its own declaration calling it 'the highest-priority debt on the board' because 'the owner's own protocol says read the toolset before any important probe' -- and it does NOT name frontier/B878_maass_upper_window/branch_cell9_rung1_v2.py, the arb-based 25-digit Maass solver behind a 58-hour run carrying B922's seal, whose filename contains neither 'maass' nor 'spectral'. All 31 sit inside five HARVEST arcs (B646, B651, B656, B663, B670) whose policy is preservation, 'ORIGINALS_MANIFEST.txt = sha256 of every file AS RECEIVED', so editing those lines would break the manifest; and the reruns were done, B646 recording them as run 'their pipeline, packet-local imports'.
